modules.title: Introduction to Sets and Logic
modules.html:
Set operations, Venn diagrams and the logic of statements. This section covers introduction to sets and logic.

Key points

  • Logic: If $$ p $$ is True and $$ q $$ is False, then $$ p \implies q $$ is: — False.
  • Logic AND: — 1.1=1.
  • Logic: p AND q is true if: — Both True.

Worked examples

Q: Logic: If $$ p $$ is True and $$ q $$ is False, then $$ p \implies q $$ is:
A: False — Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: False.

Q: Logic AND:
A: 1.1=1 — Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: 1.1=1.
